About the Position

This 4-year PhD project focuses on reactivity in supramolecular materials and related mechanochemistry projects, in collaboration with Dstl.

Project Description

This is a fully funded 3.5-year PhD studentship in the School of Chemistry, based in the Birmingham Centre for Mechanochemistry and Mechanical Processing - the UK’s premier institute for mechanochemical research - in collaboration with the UK Defence Science and Technology Laboratory (Dstl). The project is open to UK and international students from the EU, Canada, Australia, and the USA.

Project Description

This 4-year PhD project focuses on reactivity in supramolecular materials and related mechanochemistry projects, in collaboration with the UK Defence Science and Technology Laboratory (Dstl). The project is open to UK and international students from the EU, Canada, Australia, and the USA. Exact funding details are available on enquiry.

  • Application deadline: Open (as of late July 2026) - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

About University of Birmingham

The University of Birmingham is a public research university in Birmingham, England, and a Russell Group member. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral study across engineering, medicine, science, business, humanities and social sciences. Research and teaching bring together different disciplines to investigate challenges affecting health, technology, communities and the environment.

Official website: https://www.birmingham.ac.uk/

How to Apply

Contact the group via the School of Chemistry / Birmingham Centre for Mechanochemistry and Mechanical Processing to discuss fit and application steps.
